scope: Sweep allocation failures while admitting owned generated NOD and optional GROUP/IMAGE dictionary source metadata.

behavior: For root-only NOD and rooted NOD/GROUP/IMAGE profiles, the test walks allocation-failure offsets until the first offset beyond all admission allocations.
Every injected std::bad_alloc is caught; the setter rejects the candidate and preserves the previously accepted NOD, GROUP, and IMAGE state.
After every injected failure, a fresh replacement graph is accepted on the same codec and all owned dictionary handles, entries, and parent links match.
This is setup-state safety evidence only; it adds no DWG/DXF fixture and no format support claim.

limitations: The sweep covers setup-time owned dictionary admission; it does not cover subsequent writeObjects output assembly allocations.
This is local allocation-safety evidence only and establishes no DWG/DXF support or native CAD semantics.
next: Continue allocation-failure coverage across independent writeObjects builders; retain source lifetime, platform numeric/string policy, and scoped concurrency in the safety audit.
